Coding projects

Simulation, analysis and machine-learning code I’ve written during and after my PhD. Everything is open on GitHub.

2022

Computational neuroscience

Ring attractor model of persistent activity

A leaky integrate-and-fire network of the prefrontal cortex, with excitatory and inhibitory populations and AMPA, NMDA and GABA channels, running a delayed-response task. Inspired by Compte et al. (2000).

  • Excitatory neurons are tuned to one of 8 cue positions
  • A bump of activity persists through the delay period after the cue disappears
  • This is the starting point for the clustered model in my thesis
  • Python
  • Brian2

2026

Electrophysiology · data analysis

HD-MEA retina analysis

End-to-end analysis of a MaxWell MaxOne high-density microelectrode-array recording of a retina responding to moving bars. Spikes are re-detected from the raw signal and each unit's light response is characterised.

  • Spike-triggered averages mapped onto electrode positions
  • Intrinsic and stimulus-response metrics exported for every unit
  • Decodes the direction of the moving bar and tests direction selectivity with permutation tests
  • Unit-tested library, plus a resumable, checksum-verified data download
  • Python
  • HDF5
  • NumPy
  • SciPy

2022

Machine learning · NLP

Seq2seq movie-dialogue chatbot

A GRU encoder–decoder trained on the Cornell Movie-Dialogs corpus, using Word2Vec embeddings trained on the corpus itself.

  • The encoder compresses the question into one vector that conditions every decoding step
  • Greedy or temperature-sampled decoding
  • A student project from 2022, with its limitations written down honestly
  • Python
  • Keras
  • Word2Vec
